flags.why: “Bãi” does not mean a charlatan or vagabond ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/bãi)).
flags.fix: Remove this sense and its example.

flags.why: The common meaning of a small pile or puddle of bodily waste, as in “bãi nôn,” is missing ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/bãi)).
flags.fix: noun | pile; puddle (of bodily waste); ex: Trên sàn có một bãi nôn. = There is a puddle of vomit on the floor.

flags.why: “Tóm” does not mean skinny or thin ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/tóm)).
flags.fix: Remove this sense and its example.

flags.why: “Lát” names a slice but is not the verb meaning to slice ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/lát)).
flags.fix: Remove this sense and its example.

flags.why: “Xử công bằng với các con” is unnatural for treating one's children fairly.
flags.fix: Bố mẹ phải đối xử công bằng với các con. = Parents must treat their children fairly.

flags.why: “Tiến hành” is formal language for conducting or carrying out an activity and needs a register label.
This sense is a strong derogatory insult and lacks a warning tag.
flags.fix: Add the tags derogatory and offensive.
